title: Checkers: hop captures + multi-jump chains
description: Two players on 8x8 board (dark squares only). Pieces move diagonally forward, capture by hopping. Mandatory multi-jump chains when available. King promotion on back rank. Validates: hop movement primitive (untested in any current game), chain captures via repeat_until_stable or multi-action turns, mandatory capture rules, promotion. Simpler than chess but exercises primitives chess doesn't: hop and chain reactions.
close_reason: Checkers playable with 22 tests. Covers: 12-per-side initial position on dark squares, diagonal forward movement (men), capture by hop, mandatory captures, multi-jump chains, promotion to king on back rank, king backward movement and capture, game end on no legal moves. Game definition + CheckersGame helper.
